basic_details.job_title: BPSC Assistant State Architectural Auditor Recruitment 2027 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC), Patna, has invited applications for 6 posts of Assistant State Architectural Auditor under Advt No. 22/2026. The online application is open from 15 December 2026 to 14 January 2027.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online. Last date to pay the fee: 13 January 2027.

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate/Post Graduate in Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, or Forensic Science
qualification.details: Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Chemistry or Physics or Mathematics or Forensic Science from a recognized University or equivalent Age limit: 21 to 37 years (as on 1 August 2026) Age relaxation: Backward Class / Extremely Backward Class (Male and Female) 40, Unreserved Female 40, Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe (Male and Female) 42

how_to_apply: Visit the official website www.bpsc.bihar.gov.in and complete One Time Registration (OTR).
Log in to the dashboard using credentials to fill out the online application form.
Upload required documents through Digilocker or as specified.
Pay the application fee online and submit the final application.
important_instructions: Candidates must complete OTR before applying. No changes can be made to OTR details like name, father's name, mother's name, PAN, driving license, Aadhaar, mobile, email, DOB.

content_sections.heading: Key Points
content_sections.text: Last date: 14 January 2027 Vacancies: 6 How to apply: Online Fee: General: Rs. 100 Pay: Pay Level-8 Age limit: 21 to 37 years (as on 1 August 2026) Place: Bihar

content_sections.heading: BPSC Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. 22/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download BPSC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Chemistry or Physics or Mathematics or Forensic Science from a recognized University or equivalent Age limit: 21 to 37 years (as on 1 August 2026) Age relaxation: Backward Class / Extremely Backward Class (Male and Female) 40, Unreserved Female 40, Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe (Male and Female) 42

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online. Last date to pay the fee: 13 January 2027.

content_sections.heading: How Will BPSC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written Exam (Academic weightage and interview based) Interview Selection will be based on academic marks and interview marks. Maximum marks for academic qualification: 80 Maximum marks for interview: 20

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Matriculation Certificate for Date of Birth Matriculation Marksheet Intermediate Certificate Intermediate Marksheet Graduation Certificate Graduation Marksheet Post Graduate Degree/Mark sheet Caste Certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BPSC Recruitment 2027 Online
content_sections.text: Visit the official website www.bpsc.bihar.gov.in and complete One Time Registration (OTR). Log in to the dashboard using credentials to fill out the online application form. Upload required documents through Digilocker or as specified. Pay the application fee online and submit the final application. Apply on or before 14 January 2027.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates must complete OTR before applying. No changes can be made to OTR details like name, father's name, mother's name, PAN, driving license, Aadhaar, mobile, email, DOB.
